name: @harness-store/store
description: Harness Store backend: Supabase project (Auth, Postgres, Storage, Deno Edge Functions).

scripts.db:start: pnpm run build && node dist/scripts/supabase.js start
scripts.db:stop: pnpm run build && node dist/scripts/supabase.js stop
scripts.db:reset: pnpm run build && node dist/scripts/supabase.js db reset && node dist/scripts/seed.js
scripts.functions:serve: pnpm run build && node dist/scripts/supabase.js functions serve
